HANDOFF and CLAIM RELEASED
Session: ADB991-claude-20261112-6574
Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/47#issuecomment-6835524743
Branch / PR: `claude/issue-47-6574` → draft PR https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/pull/87 (base `codex/existence-monograph` at `1749b55`)

**Established (author revision, not a review).** Every manuscript and record item of the C06 review (PR #80) has been answered:
- M1: the `predictor-branch.tex` fine paths now run `Ly+i → L(y+e_b)+i`. The gradient identity holds and matches `YM.Precision.mean`/`probe`/`root_gradient`.
- M2: new `lem:branch-nearest-projection` with a full proof, valid for any closed subgroup of U(N), including disconnected and finite ones. It follows the source route (`YM.Gauge.nearest_normal`, `tubular`, `nearest_left`, `nearest_tube`, `focus_deriv`) and is used by seed-geometry and seed-energy.
- M3: new `def:geometry-sector-conditions` (S1)–(S4) with the incidence convention, matching `YM.Pressure.Stores.Plot`.
- M4: leaf-transfer now states hypotheses (A) `Slots` and (B) `KBound`, and separates the ingredient from the density.
- M5: new `lem:warning-vanishes`. It defines the contraction and proves the radius transfer from B to 2B, following `YM.ConnectedActivityE6.Coat.blowing`.
- M6: adds the order restriction `d ≤ j−2`.
- M7(a)–(f), (h) are fixed. The ledger and correspondence corrections M8 and L5/L12–L15 are recorded in `results/C06/`.
- Only M1 changes a displayed formula. Build: 890 pp, exit 0, no undefined references. `check_blueprint` OK; 22 tests OK. No Lean elaboration (Mathlib blocked).

**Uncertain.** The locators for Hall, *Lie Groups, Lie Algebras, and Representations* (2nd ed., Thm 3.42) and Krantz–Parks (2nd ed., §2.5) are from memory, because neither book was reachable; please check them against a copy. Not checked: the X2 candidate (C07 `local-covariance.tex`), and whether C07 `warning-safety.tex` supplies the plateau conclusion in exactly the form of `lem:warning-vanishes`.

**Next.**
1. A renewed independent review (mathematics + Lean correspondence) of the ten revised chapters; the hashes are in `results/C06/handoff.md`. The PR #80 review applies to the old hashes only.
2. Cross-package items for their owners (M9): C13 `actual-harvested-owner-energy.tex` should identify `c = C_1/L^2`. C11 `physical-reset-reorganization.tex` should not call its singleton-masked identity a specialization of `eq:local-atom-identity`. C08 `principal-reference-attenuation.tex` needs `d ≤ j−2`.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
